subject: cross-repo-media-batches
insight: Audit evidence first; use MP4 on the portfolio, GIF-linked MP4 on GitHub, and a static chart when only retained benchmark data is available.
evidence: Campaign used an actual synthetic-data API capture, CRM charted retained CSV measurements, and Agentic RAG reused its exported workflow graph.

subject: verify-public-social-preview-url
insight: After uploading a GitHub repository social preview, verify the public og:image URL; a successful Settings upload and readable origin object do not guarantee CDN delivery.
evidence: All six v1.5 preview PNGs matched GitHub S3 origin bytes, while every generated repository-images.githubusercontent.com URL returned Azure WebContentNotFound/404.
